results.why: This extends WC_Payment_Gateway from WooCommerce while plugins load. WordPress loads active plugins in the sorted order of their paths, and "acme-gateway/acme-gateway.php" comes before "woocommerce/woocommerce.php", so WC_Payment_Gateway is not defined yet and the site stops with a fatal error.
results.fix: Run it from a callback on plugins_loaded (or the provider's own loaded action, such as woocommerce_loaded), or check class_exists() or function_exists() first.

results.why: early-tweaks.php is a must-use plugin and creates Acme_Helper from acme-gateway while plugins load. Must-use plugins load before every regular plugin, so Acme_Helper is not defined yet and the site stops with a fatal error.
results.fix: Run it from a callback on plugins_loaded (or the provider's own loaded action, such as woocommerce_loaded), or check class_exists() or function_exists() first.

results.why: This extends WC_Payment_Gateway from WooCommerce while plugins load, behind a check that it exists. "guarded-gateway/guarded-gateway.php" loads before "woocommerce/woocommerce.php", so the check always fails at that moment and the code behind it never runs: no error, and no feature.
results.fix: Move the check and the code into a callback on plugins_loaded (or the provider's own loaded action), where the provider is always there if it is active.

results.why: This creates Acme_Helper from acme-gateway while plugins load. It works only because "acme-gateway/acme-gateway.php" sorts before "zeta-addon/zeta-addon.php". It breaks if the provider's folder is renamed, if this plugin is network-activated while the provider is not (network plugins load first), or if the code moves into a must-use plugin.
results.fix: Run it from a callback on plugins_loaded (or the provider's own loaded action, such as woocommerce_loaded), or check class_exists() or function_exists() first.
